FIELDS.NAME: Climate Comfort Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Climate Comfort Solutions specializes in the sales, installation, and maintenance of residential and light commercial heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems. Our operations include providing expert consultations to assess customer needs, recommending energy-efficient HVAC solutions, and ensuring rigorous installation practices conducted by our certified and licensed technicians. We pride ourselves on our commitment to safety, maintaining a comprehensive written safety program and conducting regular safety training sessions for our staff. Furthermore, we ensure compliance with EPA regulations concerning refrigerant handling, which includes proper recovery and disposal methods to minimize environmental impact. Our team is dedicated to exceptional customer service, with ongoing support available through maintenance contracts and emergency repair services. We do not engage in high-risk operations, such as work on high-rise buildings or hazardous industrial environments, which allows us to focus on delivering quality service to our clients in a safe and compliant manner.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates: 06/15/2022; Cause: Equipment failure during installation; Amount: $2,000; Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Secured storage (Class B, Grade 1) for essential documents and equipment, complying with local fire codes and safety regulations.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secured perimeter fencing with 24/7 watchperson oversight.
